keys.vi: Giá trị được bảo vệ có thể vẫn bị khoá
keys.ja: 保護された値がロックされたままになる可能性があります
keys.context: ImportView — title of the warning banner shown in the pre-import preview and again in the import result, when a payload carries Extra Password sealed values that this device will not be able to open.

keys.key: This device already has its own Extra Password. Any value this backup sealed with a different one will not open here.
keys.en: This device already has its own Extra Password. Any value this backup sealed with a different one will not open here.
keys.vi: Thiết bị này đã có Mật khẩu cấp 2 riêng. Mọi giá trị mà bản sao lưu đã niêm phong bằng một mật khẩu khác sẽ không mở được ở đây.
keys.ja: この端末にはすでに独自の第 2 パスワードがあります。このバックアップが別のパスワードで封印した値は、ここでは開けません。
keys.context: ImportView — warning body when the backup's Level-2 wrap is refused because the device already holds its own. Deliberately says "will not open" rather than "is lost": re-importing your own backup onto the same device still opens.

keys.key: The Extra Password settings in this backup were refused, so values it sealed will not open here.
keys.en: The Extra Password settings in this backup were refused, so values it sealed will not open here.
keys.vi: Cài đặt Mật khẩu cấp 2 trong bản sao lưu này đã bị từ chối, nên các giá trị mà nó niêm phong sẽ không mở được ở đây.
keys.ja: このバックアップの第 2 パスワード設定は拒否されたため、封印された値はここでは開けません。
keys.context: ImportView — warning body when the backup's Level-2 wrap fails the KDF policy or salt check and is refused.

keys.key: This backup has sealed values but not the Extra Password key for them, so they will not open here.
keys.en: This backup has sealed values but not the Extra Password key for them, so they will not open here.
keys.vi: Bản sao lưu này có giá trị đã niêm phong nhưng không kèm khoá Mật khẩu cấp 2, nên chúng sẽ không mở được ở đây.
keys.ja: このバックアップには封印された値がありますが、その第 2 パスワードの鍵がないため、ここでは開けません。
keys.context: ImportView — warning body when the payload carries Extra Password sealed values but no Level-2 wrap at all.

keys.ja: このまま読み込みますか。
keys.context: ImportView — confirmation dialog title before an import that would leave Extra Password sealed values unreadable.
ImportView — confirm button in the stranding dialog.
ImportView — header of the per-category result section shown when an import did not restore everything.
ImportView — result row label counting Spaces the import had to create for folder names in the file. Uses the app's Space terminology (VI: Nhóm).
ImportView — result row label for restored artifact attachments.

keys.key: This backup file is damaged and can’t be opened.
keys.en: This backup file is damaged and can’t be opened.
keys.vi: Tệp sao lưu này bị hỏng và không thể mở.
keys.ja: このバックアップファイルは破損しており、開けません。
keys.context: ImportView — shown for a malformed file (rejected Argon2 parameters, a salt Argon2 refuses, an empty payload, a corrupt artifact). Exists specifically so it is NOT reported as a wrong password.

keys.key: This file is too large to import safely.
keys.en: This file is too large to import safely.
keys.vi: Tệp này quá lớn để nhập một cách an toàn.
keys.ja: このファイルは大きすぎるため、安全に読み込めません。
keys.context: ImportView — file or sealed-payload byte ceiling refused before the file is read into memory.

keys.key: This file holds more records than one import can restore safely.
keys.en: This file holds more records than one import can restore safely.
keys.vi: Tệp này chứa nhiều bản ghi hơn mức một lần nhập có thể khôi phục an toàn.
keys.ja: このファイルには、1 回の読み込みで安全に復元できる数を超えるレコードが含まれています。
keys.context: ImportView — row, passkey or artifact count ceiling exceeded.

keys.vi: Một số tệp đính kèm không thể đưa vào
keys.ja: 一部の添付ファイルを含められません
keys.context: ExportView — confirmation dialog title when an encrypted backup would omit attachments whose bytes this device cannot produce.
ExportView — confirm button accepting an incomplete backup.

keys.key: Some attachments could not be read on this device. The backup will restore everything else.
keys.en: Some attachments could not be read on this device. The backup will restore everything else.
keys.vi: Một số tệp đính kèm không đọc được trên thiết bị này. Bản sao lưu sẽ khôi phục mọi thứ còn lại.
keys.ja: この端末で読み取れない添付ファイルがあります。バックアップはそれ以外のすべてを復元します。
keys.context: ExportView — message body of the incomplete-attachments dialog. Count-neutral on purpose so no plural rule is needed.

keys.key: This file is removed when you leave this screen, when the app is backgrounded, and when the vault locks.
keys.en: This file is removed when you leave this screen, when the app is backgrounded, and when the vault locks.
keys.vi: Tệp này sẽ bị xoá khi bạn rời màn hình này, khi ứng dụng chuyển xuống nền và khi kho khoá lại.
keys.ja: このファイルは、この画面を離れたとき、アプリがバックグラウンドに移ったとき、保管庫がロックされたときに削除されます。
keys.context: ExportView — footer under Share Export, telling the user how long the export file lives (it is plaintext for a CSV export).

keys.key: The attachments in this vault total more than %lld MB, which is more than one backup can hold. Remove some attachments and try again.
keys.en: The attachments in this vault total more than %lld MB, which is more than one backup can hold. Remove some attachments and try again.
keys.vi: Tệp đính kèm trong kho này có tổng dung lượng hơn %lld MB, vượt quá mức một bản sao lưu có thể chứa. Hãy xoá bớt tệp đính kèm rồi thử lại.
keys.ja: この保管庫の添付ファイルは合計 %lld MB を超えており、1 つのバックアップに収まりません。添付ファイルを減らしてからもう一度お試しください。

notes: Reused, already in the catalog with vi + ja, nothing to merge: 'Cancel', 'Done', 'Items', 'Passkeys', '%lld of %lld', 'Couldn’t decrypt, check the password.', 'Couldn’t read the file.', 'Unsupported file format.', 'No items found in that file.', 'Backup contained no records.', 'Unlock your vault before importing passkeys.'

'Couldn’t decrypt, check the password.' is now used ONLY for a genuine authentication failure. Everything that is a property of the file routes to the new 'This backup file is damaged and can’t be opened.' key.

'Couldn’t open the file.' is no longer emitted by ImportView (a security-scope failure and a read failure both report 'Couldn’t read the file.' now). The key is still used elsewhere; do not prune it on account of this change.
All apostrophes use U+2019 to match the rest of the catalog. No '!', no em dash, no '·' in any user-facing string.
